section_title: Schedule levels, critical path and float
text: The schedule has three levels. Level 1: contract key dates and milestones (Notice to Proceed, back-feed energisation, GT first fire, first synchronisation in combined cycle, Taking-Over) as shown in ALP-EPC-00000-GE-PLN-0001. Level 2: phases and the work areas (CWA) with their construction work packages (CWP). Level 3: the CPM network of activities (activity records) with durations in working days, logic links (FS, SS, FF, SF with lags), constraints, deliverable documents and budget hours; it is issued as ALP-EPC-00000-PC-SCH-0001.
